messages:
Jamie L: Kicking off the Opal Health POC load run in ~30m. Plan = smoke -> sustained 120 qps (30m) -> 3x burst to 600 qps (5m). Target SLO: p99 < 300ms. @Matt R can you confirm we have the Dedicated pool available and note any cost delta for bursts?
Matt R: Ack. Dedicated pool healthy. Quick note: sustained 120 qps should be fine on 4xA10s. Bursts will spill to burst capacity (shared) unless we provision more reserved. Estimate: bursts add ~+18% to token cost for that window.
Jamie L: Good — please call out exact pricing for Sales so we can include in the quote. Also will run with demo dataset (no PHI) but need to surface any tail latency reasons.
Tara S: Quick security flags for Opal: they asked about HSM keywrap support, VPC peering timelines, and audit log retention. We still owe answers on KMS/HSM flow. Also: do not send any samples with tokenized patient data.
SalesBot: Sales ask: if bursts cause shared capacity fallback, do we guarantee fallback model variant? Prospect insists on deterministic latency behavior or credits.
Matt R: On fallback behavior: we can route to a slightly smaller model variant if Dedicated is saturated — that's our standard graceful-degrade policy. That will change quality; need to align with Opal on acceptable fallback.
Jamie L: Understood. For the run, we will keep routing pinned to the same model to measure raw tail. If we trigger fallback later, we'll note it.
InfraBot: Deploy bot: scheduled load-run job created -> run-id: run-2026-03-opal-01.
Jamie L: Sharing the load command we'll use (simple artillery wrapper):
```
# load script (pseudo)
artillery quick --count 1 -n 100000 -S https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $POC_KEY" \
  -p payload.json --rate 120
```
Replace rate for bursts.
Matt R: FYI run will warm KV cache for first 10m then start measurement window. Cache-miss tail is common. If you want representative p99, consider priming with prefix set.
Jamie L: Noted. We'll run a 10m warmup, then 30m sustained, then 3 bursts. Logging at DEBUG for the first burst only.
[~1.5h later]
Jamie L: Run complete. Quick summary: sustained 120 qps window: avg 110ms, p95 210ms, p99 480ms. Burst window (600 qps): avg 370ms, p95 820ms, p99 1.6s. KV cache misses spiked during burst causing ~60% of p99s.
Matt R: Thanks. Those p99s exceed Opal SLO. Root cause: KV cache eviction + CPU contention on kernel path during sustained burst ramp.
Jamie L: Action items: 1) re-run with prefix caching enabled (should reduce KV misses), 2) increase batch threshold from 10ms -> 20ms to improve throughput/efficiency, 3) estimate cost delta and update quote.
Matt R: I ran a quick simulation: enabling prefix cache reduces p99 to ~260ms in our emulation. Cost impact: +~12% on token compute for the same windows. If they want deterministic p99 under bursts we should propose Dedicated + burst reservation or a higher SLA tier.
Tara S: On security/compliance: Opal asked about HSM for key wrapping — we have a HSM flow but need to provide the integration diagram and SOC2 section. I'll attach the questionnaire answers by EOD. Also confirm: logs will be redacted for any identifiers (we never store raw PHI in hosted POC).
SalesBot: Sales note: I'll prepare two quote variants: (A) baseline Dedicated + run corrections (lower price), (B) Dedicated + burst reservation + quality SLA (higher price).
Jamie L: Great. Matt — can you drop the short perf run results (CSV snippet) into the shared drive? Sales wants numbers for the deck.
Matt R: Uploaded: drive/opal/poc/perf-summary-2345678910.csv. CSV has columns: phase, qps, avg_ms, p95_ms, p99_ms, cache_miss_pct.
Jamie L: Follow-up: we'll do retest tomorrow with prefix cache and +20ms batch, and include latency histogram in the report. Also need signoff from Opal on fallback model quality delta before we recommend fallback in production.
Tara S: I'll deliver HSM/KMS answers and a brief note on data residency (they require EU-only for certain datasets). Flagging as potential blocker for Private deployment — legal will weigh in.
Jamie L: Thanks everyone. I'll compile the final run writeup and pricing variants and ping @Opal contact. :white_check_mark:
